name: Heavy Pressure
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:sound+)(Tag:tool)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Great Tremor", Heavy Pressure is a microphone Teigu turning your voice into stone-shattering shockwaves and amplifying sound-based abilities. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master and can only be used by compatible people, usually cheerful young women for some reason.
